// Writes a small synthetic JPEG: a gradient with a square, no photograph.
package main

import (
	"image"
	"image/color"
	"image/jpeg"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	img := image.NewRGBA(image.Rect(0, 0, 64, 48))
	for y := 0; y < 48; y++ {
		for x := 0; x < 64; x++ {
			c := color.RGBA{uint8(x * 4), uint8(y * 5), 160, 255}
			if x >= 8 && x < 24 && y >= 8 && y < 24 {
				c = color.RGBA{200, 40, 40, 255}
			}
			img.Set(x, y, c)
		}
	}
	f, _ := os.Create(os.Args[1])
	defer f.Close()
	jpeg.Encode(f, img, &jpeg.Options{Quality: 75})
}
